descriptions.online: Encrypt a message or files and get a one-time link. The key travels inside the link and never reaches the server.
descriptions.traditional: Encrypt locally with a password, without sending anything to any server. You decide how to share the code.
descriptions.message: Paste a link or an encrypted code to see its content.
descriptions.requests: Ask someone to send you a secret: it's encrypted in their browser and only you can open it.

share.passwordHint: Second factor: besides the link, this password will be required. Share it through another channel.
share.destroyHint: Deleted from the server the first time it's opened.
share.note: Your browser encrypts everything with AES-256-GCM before sending it. The server only stores encrypted data, including file names, and never receives the key.
share.linkWarning: This link contains the key: anyone with the full link can read the message. Only send it to the intended person.
share.passwordReminder: You added a password: share it through a different channel than the link.
share.destroyReminder: It will be destroyed when opened, so there's no preview: opening it now would delete it.

encrypt.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A long passphrase is best: it's the only thing protecting this code.
encrypt.note: Everything happens in your browser: nothing is sent to the server. Share the code and the password through different channels.
encrypt.qrTooLarge: The code is too long for a QR (1,800 characters max).
encrypt.qrCaption: Scan it to copy the encrypted code

decrypt.linkDescription: The key is in the link and is only used in this browser.
decrypt.extraPassword: This message also requires a password
decrypt.destroyWarning: This message will be deleted from the server when opened. You can only see it once: save what you need.
decrypt.burnedNotice: The message has been deleted from the server. If you close this page you won't be able to see it again.
decrypt.notFoundHint: It may have expired, already been read, or the link may be incomplete.
decrypt.note: Accepts Share links and codes from the Encrypt tab, including the previous format.

detected.none: Not a valid link or code

requests.labelLabel: What do you need them to send?
requests.labelHint: Shown to the responder. It travels inside the link and isn't stored on the server.
requests.passcodeHint: If set, your inbox link is useless without this passcode. Useful if you save it on your phone or in notes.
requests.saveHint: It will show up in "My requests". With a passcode, it's stored encrypted.
requests.note: Your browser generates a key pair. The responder encrypts with your public key and only your private key, which never leaves your links, can open it.
requests.step1Title: Send this link to whoever should respond
requests.step1Text: With it they can send you an encrypted message or files. It can only be answered once.
requests.step2Text: It's the only way to read the answer. Save it now: scan the QR with your phone or copy it.
requests.step2TextSaved: It's saved in this browser. To open it from another device, scan the QR or copy it.
requests.plainNote: Anyone with this link can read the answer. Don't share it.
requests.lockedNote: Protected with a passcode: without it, the link can't open the answer.
requests.inboxQrCaption: Scan it to save the inbox on your phone
requests.empty: No requests saved in this browser yet.

respond.title: You've been asked to send a secret
respond.explanation: It's encrypted in your browser with the requester's public key. Neither the server nor anyone else can read it. It can only be answered once.
respond.sentText: The requester can now open it from their inbox.
respond.goneTitle: The request doesn't exist or has expired
respond.goneText: Ask whoever sent it to create a new one.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.lockedText: Enter the passcode you chose when creating the request.
inbox.pendingText: No answer yet. This page refreshes every 15 seconds.
inbox.answeredText: The answer arrived. Opening it deletes it from the server: save what you need.
inbox.retrievedNotice: The answer has been deleted from the server. If you close this page you won't be able to see it again.
inbox.goneText: It expired, was deleted, or the answer was already opened.
inbox.invalidTitle: The inbox link is not valid

messagePlaceholder: Paste the link or the encrypted code
destroyOnNextFail: the message will be deleted if you fail again

error.noContent: Type a message or attach files
error.messageTooLong: The message is too long (10,000 characters max)
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. The message was deleted.
error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.tooLarge: The content exceeds the maximum allowed size
error.storageFull: The server has no space available right now. Try again later.

warning.keyTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters

share.title: Share
share.text: Encrypt a message and files in your browser and get a link. The key goes in the part of the link after #, which browsers never send to the server. You can add a password as a second factor, set an expiration and make it self-destruct after reading.

encrypt.title: Encrypt
encrypt.text: Encrypt locally with a password (PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations and AES-256-GCM) and get a code to share however you like. Nothing is stored on the server.

requests.title: Request
requests.text: Create a link so someone else can send you a secret. Their browser encrypts it with your public key and only your inbox link can open it. You can protect it with a passcode and save it on your phone by scanning the QR.

security.title: What the server sees
security.text: Only encrypted, authenticated data: not the text, not the file names, not the key. Knowing a message's identifier isn't enough to read or delete it. Failed attempts and abuse are rate-limited and logged.

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.text: Use long passwords, preferably a passphrase, and share them through a different channel than the link or code.
